title: Add more docs
body:
vibin so much with eshkol
thank you for starting this, its really needed man, lets make it big


This pull request includes several updates to the documentation for Eshkol, focusing on automatic differentiation, function composition, and getting started guides. The most important changes include comprehensive guides and practical examples for new users, detailed explanations of core concepts, and troubleshooting tips.

Documentation Enhancements:

* [`docs/aidocs/AUTODIFF.md`](diffhunk://#diff-f902a0b463ac75be73a74aaaf5c36d66bc1d1330f276fb6bfb51bcb4dc5b4c52R1-R215): Added a detailed guide on automatic differentiation in Eshkol, including forward-mode and reverse-mode differentiation, implementation details, code examples, and troubleshooting tips.
* [`docs/aidocs/FUNCTION_COMPOSITION.md`](diffhunk://#diff-c10eedd16f98cba4ed37ab829e64cc9c23058564d08ceabe89fbd2c0d7b195ffR1-R243): Introduced a comprehensive overview of function composition in Eshkol, covering closure implementation, core components, code examples, best practices, performance considerations, and troubleshooting.
* [`docs/aidocs/GETTING_STARTED.md`](diffhunk://#diff-ac2ee46348207671c7fde71e3b8ec2212c903a1067144145198fdc9d1dd980c8R1-R305): Created a getting started guide for Eshkol, including installation instructions, basic syntax, common operations, development environment setup, debugging, and performance profiling.g
author: 0xrinegade

title: Minor adjustments for Linux compilation
body:
add `#include <stdint.h>` in `eshkol/src/core/memory/memory_tracking.c`
fix error: 
`eshkol/src/core/memory/memory_tracking.c:53:14: error: ‘uintptr_t’ undeclared (first use in this function)`

add `#include <xmmintrin.h>` in `include/core/simd.h`
fix error: 
`eshkol/src/core/utils/vector.c:228:9: error: unknown type name ‘__m128’; did you mean ‘__int128’?`

add `-lm` to `CMakeLists.txt`
fix error: 
`undefined reference to sqrtf`
